command_runs: Candidate-local portable descriptor only: exercise the ARGUS2-VS-01..07 validation scenarios through the real public API, the real CLI and a real accepted compiler plan. The trusted host policy binds the executable validation command and its discovery check.
note: The 30 identifiers are the union of the eight ARGUS2-VS scenario test_ids declared in engineering/validation/scenarios (equality re-checked while this record was generated). Twenty-five preserve the pre-rework VS-01..VS-07 regression cases unchanged; the five additive cases of ARGUS2-VS-08 bind the terminal-review repairs AR-F01-AR-F05 (frozen adversarial cases ARGUS2-ADV-01-ARGUS2-ADV-07). Every one of the twelve accepted ARGUS2-SR-001..012 software requirements is validated by at least one scenario, and each scenario's test_ids are a subset of this record's test_ids. The scenarios cover the required failure, uncertainty, retention, recovery, security and metamorphic cases: digest mutation and unsupported versions, duplicate identity and non-finite values, missing clock domain/unit, exceeded caller bounds, unsafe paths and symlink escapes, truncated stream and interrupted finalization, known loss and unmet obligations, missing causal and interval closure, non-mutating recovery, installed-wheel consumer compatibility, additive unknown-field/unknown-major behaviour and byte-stable repeated reads. The VS-08 cases additionally require pre-I/O confined and bounded reads with caller-authoritative limits, recorded-versus-assessed corrupt-evidence status that is never primary complete, strict closed nested schemas and identities with only stable bounded diagnostics, the actual serialized manifest byte bound at every publication, and admission snapshot isolation against caller mutation of obligations and returned views. Scientific protocol values remain caller inputs.
title: ARGUS2 intended-use validation (caller, analyst, integrator, operator, maintainer, metamorphic and adversarial repair cases)
